newsitem.title: USA: Seagate Technology sets $700 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Seagate Technology sets $700 mln in debt.

text.p: The following issue from Seagate Technology Inc was priced on Thursday via lead manager Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, market sources said.
The deal was upped in size to $700 million from an initial $450 million size to meet investor demand, sources added.
